dedupe_keys.name: projektionsmodell fur f gas emissions inventare profi

description: Projektionsmodell für F-Gas-Emissions-Inventare (ProFi) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Öko-Institut. Creation of projections of the F-gas emissions shown in the German GHG inventory, mapping of the complete range of F-gas emissions from all emitting application areas and production processes. The modeling approach differs significantly between the different emission source groups mapped and ranges from trend extrapolations to stock-change modeling. Coverage: Germany. Methodical focus: F-Gas emission calculation, trend extrapolation, stock-change modelling. Time resolution: annual. Software: MS Excel. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
